为什么"生态位分化"让众多物种能在同一环境里共存？

Why does "niche differentiation" let many species coexist in one environment?

通过错开食物、空间、时间或行为，物种把资源"切"成不同份额，谁都不必正面硬抢；这种细分让有限资源养活更多种类。
By splitting food, space, time or behavior, species carve resources into shares so none must fight head-on; that fine division lets limited resources support more kinds.

什么是"生态位"——为什么两种鸟能在同一棵树上共存？

What is an "ecological niche"—why can two bird species share one tree?

生态位是物种的"职业"：吃哪层叶、何时觅食、怎么筑巢都不同；两只鸟若错开食物与时间，就等于占了不同"工位"，便相安无事。
A niche is a species' "job": which leaves it eats, when it forages, how it nests. Two birds using different food and times occupy different "desks" and coexist.

"竞争排斥原理"为什么被称为生态学的基石？

Why is the "competitive exclusion principle" called a cornerstone of ecology?

它说两个生态位完全一样的物种无法长期共存，必有一方被挤出；这解释了为何自然界总是"你吃你的、我吃我的"，多样性由此维持。
It states two species with identical niches can't coexist long—one is excluded. It explains why nature runs on "you eat yours, I eat mine," sustaining diversity.
